subject.title: [Feature]: Slack Block Kit support for agent messages

question: Should OpenClaw bless a Slack-native Block Kit producer path for trusted reports/tables/rich_text, or keep portable `presentation` as the only supported rich-output producer API and split richer native layouts into a separate design?
rationale: Current code can send raw blocks and render portable presentations, but choosing a documented provider-native report/table API would define a user-facing Slack contract beyond a mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Keep This Issue Canonical
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers choose the Slack-native producer boundary, then close it only after the chosen path is documented or split into a narrower live issue.

options.title: Bless Slack-Native Producers
options.body: Document trusted producer use of Slack Block Kit with required fallback text, validation limits, examples, and live Slack proof before implementation PRs proceed.

options.title: Portable Presentation Only
options.body: Document that raw Slack blocks remain lower-level or legacy escape hatches and track metric fields, tables, and rich_text conversion as future portable presentation schema work.

recommendation.title: Keep This Issue Canonical
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers choose the Slack-native producer boundary, then close it only after the chosen path is documented or split into a narrower live issue.
